## Scope and owner

Link the owning issue. Name the outcome, risk class, affected paths and reviewer.

## Contract and consumer impact

Identify affected producers, consumers, schemas, persisted state and generated artifacts. Include the generator or explain why it does not apply.

## Verification

Record the exact head, commands, results, and remaining proof gaps. Link relevant CI, negative cases and downstream canaries. Include sanitized summaries only.

## Migration and rollback

Describe compatibility, migration, rollback and any approval needed before effects become irreversible.
